{{Quote|The Hutt Cartel has always appreciated boldness. We are amenable to your offer, Captain.|Raskurro the Hutt|<ref name="message">{{TORcite|type=message|Pleasure doing bussiness with you|Raskurro the Hutt}}</ref>}}
'''Raskurro''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who served as a member of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
By [[3642 BBY]]<ref name="Date">{{TOR dates|2}} Raskurro appears at the end of Act II for the smuggler class, placing his appearance around 3642 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]</ref> the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] had apprehended the [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Combo]], who was wanted by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Rogun Matt'rik|Rogun the Butcher]]. Raskurro was negotiating the handover of Combo to Rogun's [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] lieutenant [[Strilth]] when a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], along with Combo's captain [[Vaz Traniff]], interrupted them. The smuggler convinced Raskurro to ally with them over Rogun, and Raskurro left them to fight with Strilth over Combo.<ref name="Modest Proposals" />

Raskurro later contacted the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] to apologize for the incident on behalf of the Hutt Cartel.<ref name="message" />
